summary: Three blocking findings are valid and should be repaired in spec.json. All are small spec-level clarifications for non-interactive setup and existing setup defaults.

items.title: Non-interactive multi-agent main selection is ambiguous
items.rationale: The current spec does not define which family is main when --agent supplies multiple families, so R2/R3 acceptance cannot be implemented or tested deterministically.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[0]; spec.json R3 mentions --agent claude,codex but no main/default selection rule.

items.title: Non-interactive instruction-file targets are undefined for multi-agent setup
items.rationale: The current spec decouples generation targets in interactive setup but leaves non-interactive multi-agent generation behavior undefined.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[1]; spec.json R6 and T-2 mention target selection but no --agent default target behavior.

items.title: Existing config setup defaults are not specified
items.rationale: Rerunning setup is a retained public behavior, and the spec must define how existing concrete keys and useProfile values become wizard defaults.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[2]; src/setup.js loadExistingDefaults currently reads cfg.agent.default literally.
